# Sources

Verbatim copies. Nested `SKILL.md` files are renamed `UPSTREAM.md` so Cuti's catalog does not
register them as extra skills. Do not rewrite the bodies.

## Bitwize (CC0)

Copied: `skills/{lyric-writer,lyric-refiner,pronunciation-specialist,lyric-reviewer,pre-generation-check,voice-checker,suno-engineer,explicit-checker}` and `reference/suno/*`.
Not copied: album pipeline, research agents, mix/mastering, promo, MCP server, 72 genre production folders.
